test_markdown_renders: test that source Markdown text renders to expected HTML output using assertMarkdownRenders
test_legacy_file_based: test Markdown rendering against a directory of input text and expected HTML output files
test_recursion_limit: test deeply nested Markdown content by temporarily lowering the Python recursion limit
review_TestCase_class: review the TestCase subclass that provides assertMarkdownRenders and dedent helpers for Markdown tests
review_LegacyTestCase_class: review the LegacyTestCase metaclass that auto-generates file-based Markdown tests from a directory
